system.description:
You possess a working understanding of what makes things tick. With time, tools and parts, you can fix or slightly alter most of the trappings of modern society — and the same knowledge lets you excel at sabotage. Repair is widespread among inventors, mechanics and handymen.

Using Repair usually calls for a Mental Challenge whose difficulty depends on the item's complexity, tools and parts available, extent of damage and time spent.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
